sample_unit: participants across 3 randomized experiments used for calibration (9 empirical data points)

links.outcome: Predicted human-AI team error by AI accuracy, clinician experience, and task complexity (overreliance)
links.effect: Simulated novice×high-complexity error rates of roughly 26% to 41% at AI accuracy 0.5-0.7; AI accuracy of 0.89 needed for error <10%.
links.quote: At the moderate accuracy levels currently reported for general-purpose LLMs on complex clinical tasks (approximately 0.5-0.7), the model predicts error rates of roughly 26% to 41% in this high-risk condition.

unlisted_practices: Deriving minimum AI accuracy thresholds (Athreshold) by user experience and task complexity to set acceptable error targets

screen.reason: Empirical simulation study evaluating safe AI accuracy thresholds and clinician reliance dynamics across task complexity and user experience levels.

primary.practice: AI accuracy threshold setting based on user experience and task complexity
